evade.name: Evade
evade.tooltip: Each stack adds 3 Evasion. Lose 1 stack at the start of each round.

weak.name: Weak
weak.tooltip: Deals 25% less attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.tooltip: Takes 25% more attack damage. 1 stack expires each turn.

frail.name: Frail
frail.tooltip: Gains 25% less Block from cards. 1 stack expires each turn.

bleed.name: Bleed
bleed.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, plus {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage — then the build-up resets to zero. Fleshy targets briefly resist further Bleed after a burst.

frost.name: Frost
frost.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, and the target is left Weak and Frost-Exposed — then the build-up resets to zero.

insanity.name: Insanity
insanity.tooltip: Build-up: points do not decay. At {proc.threshold}, burst for {proc.burstPercent}% of max HP (min {proc.burstMin}, max {proc.burstMax}), ignoring Block, with {proc.poiseDamage} Poise damage and a guaranteed Stagger — then the build-up resets to zero.

bleedResist.name: Clotted
bleedResist.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Bleed: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

frostResist.name: Weathered
frostResist.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Frost: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

insanityResist.name: Resolute
insanityResist.tooltip: Just burst — hardened against Insanity: incoming build-up reduced {resists.percent}% for {decay.duration} turns.

frostExposed.name: Frost-Exposed
frostExposed.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from starstone attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.

insanityExposed.name: Unraveled
insanityExposed.tooltip: Takes {tv.pct}% more damage from ritual and blight attacks. Stacks with Vulnerable. {decay.duration} turns.

crimsonBlight.name: Crimson Blight
crimsonBlight.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Blight stacks (ignores Block). Stacks do not tick down; the Blight expires entirely after 3 turns. Re-applying adds stacks and refreshes the duration.

necroticBlight.name: Necrotic Blight
necroticBlight.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Necrotic Blight stacks (ignores Block). Applied by Necrotic damage. Stacks do not tick down and it lasts the whole fight; only a cleanse removes it.

burn.name: Burn
burn.tooltip: At the start of its turn, loses HP equal to Burn stacks (ignores Block). One stack burns out each turn.

regen.name: Regen
regen.tooltip: At the start of its turn, heals HP equal to Regen stacks. Lasts the whole fight.

madness.name: Madness
madness.tooltip: At the start of your turn: lose 2 HP per stack, gain 1 Energy per stack, then Madness clears.

staggered.name: Staggered
staggered.tooltip: Poise broken: skips its next turn and takes 50% more attack damage until the end of your next turn.

rallyingStandard.name: Rallying Standard
rallyingStandard.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength and take 1 damage (per stack).

rallyingStandardUp.name: Rallying Standard+
rallyingStandardUp.tooltip: At the start of your turn: gain 1 Strength (per stack).

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 30.

unbreakableUp.name: Unbreakable+
unbreakableUp.tooltip: Block no longer expires at the start of your turn. Block is capped at 40.

goreblood.name: Goreblood
goreblood.tooltip: Poise thresholds no longer increase after filling.

sanguinePact.name: Sanguine Pact
sanguinePact.tooltip: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain 2 Strength per stack.

starstoneCharge.name: Starstone Charge
starstoneCharge.tooltip: A spell was cast this turn: your next Starstone bonus is live. Fades at end of turn.

stargazer.name: Stargazer
stargazer.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge.

astralArmor.name: Astral Armor
astralArmor.tooltip: At the end of your turn, gain 4 Block per stack.

constellation.name: Constellation
constellation.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, deal 4 damage per stack to a random enemy.

azureCoil.name: Azure Coil
azureCoil.tooltip: Whenever you play a Skill, gain 2 Block per stack.

waxingMoon.name: Waxing Moon
waxingMoon.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Vulnerable to ALL enemies per stack.

moonlitShield.name: Moonlit Shield
moonlitShield.tooltip: Whenever you gain Starstone Charge, gain 3 Block per stack.

astromancer.name: Astromancer
astromancer.tooltip: At the start of your turn, gain Starstone Charge and draw a card.

thornHalo.name: Thorn Halo
thornHalo.tooltip: At the start of your turn, apply 1 Crimson Blight per stack to ALL enemies.

communion.name: Communion
communion.tooltip: At the start of your turn, heal 3 HP per stack.

lifeTithe.name: Life Tithe
lifeTithe.tooltip: Whenever an enemy dies, heal 8 HP per stack.

stigmata.name: Stigmata
stigmata.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, heal 2 HP per stack.

zealotry.name: Zealotry
zealotry.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, deal 3 damage to a random enemy per stack.

emberTide.name: Ember Tide
emberTide.tooltip: Whenever you heal, gain 1 Strength per stack.

harbingerOfBlight.name: Harbinger of Blight
harbingerOfBlight.tooltip: Whenever you apply Blight (Crimson or Necrotic) to an enemy, heal 1 HP per stack.

bloodUnction.name: Blood Unction
bloodUnction.tooltip: Your attacks apply 2 extra Bleed per hit this turn.

ironVow.name: Iron Vow
ironVow.tooltip: Whenever you lose HP, gain 3 Block per stack.

bulwarkEcho.name: Shieldwall Echo
bulwarkEcho.tooltip: At the start of your next turn: gain 4 Block per stack.

prepared.name: Prepared
prepared.tooltip: Your next setup payoff is empowered. Expires at turn end.

venom.name: Venom
venom.tooltip: At turn start, lose HP equal to Venom. 1 stack expires each turn.

afterimage.name: Afterimage
afterimage.tooltip: Every third card played each combat grants 3 Block per stack.

deadlyTempo.name: Deadly Tempo
deadlyTempo.tooltip: At turn start, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.

opportunist.name: Opportunist
opportunist.tooltip: When an enemy staggers, become Prepared and draw 1 card per stack.

envenom.name: Envenom
envenom.tooltip: Your attacks apply 1 Venom per stack.

glassCannon.name: Glass Cannon
glassCannon.tooltip: Deal 25% more attack damage, and take 25% more.

magicVulnerable.name: Magic Vulnerable
magicVulnerable.tooltip: Magic-school HP damage is increased while this lasts.

stanceShifted.name: Stance Shifted
stanceShifted.tooltip: You have entered a stance this fight: Oath cards no longer grant Block.

silenced.name: Silenced
silenced.tooltip: Spells cost 1 more Stamina per stack. Immune to Force: each Force hit or effect is stopped and removes 1 stack.

stoneskin.name: Stoneskin
stoneskin.tooltip: Your Block is not removed at the start of your next turn.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.tooltip: Lose 1 HP per stack at turn start. Bodily Chance Recovery.

frozen.name: Frozen
frozen.tooltip: One stack denies one Action. Fire thaws; Blunt shatters. Elemental Chance Recovery.

chilled.name: Chilled
chilled.tooltip: The next connected Blunt action deals 25% more damage. Fire thaws.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.tooltip: Locks ordinary cards, Counter and card Evade. Rest restores up to 6 HP and 1 Ward per combat. +10% direct damage received per active stack. Break Sleep: 2 SP per stack.

paralysis.name: Paralysis
paralysis.tooltip: Locks ordinary cards, Counter and card Evade. Break Paralysis: 3 SP per stack. Grounding clears its pressure.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.tooltip: Locks ordinary cards, Counter and card Evade. Clear Dazed: 1 SP per stack.

offBalance.name: Off Balance
offBalance.tooltip: Disadvantage on bodily recovery. One stack expires at turn end.

prone.name: Prone
prone.tooltip: +25% Contact damage, −25% Single Near/Far damage. +2/+4 Evade against Near/Far Martial weapons. Stand Up: 1 SP after hand locks clear.

grounded.name: Grounded
grounded.tooltip: Prevents electrical conductivity and backlash; grants Advantage on Paralysis recovery.

invulnerability.name: Invulnerability
invulnerability.tooltip: Consume one stack to avoid the next direct damaging action, including all its hits. Status buildup still applies; no Counter return. Damage over time does not consume it.

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.tooltip: Consume one stack to avoid a Single Near/Far damaging action. Status buildup still applies. Sweep and Holy revelation clear it.

concealed.name: Concealed
concealed.tooltip: Concealment. Sweep and Holy revelation clear it.

confused.name: Confused
confused.tooltip: Deals 10% less damage. At the start of its turn, 50% chance to take 3 Poise damage per stack. 1 stack expires each turn.

slowed.name: Slowed
slowed.tooltip: Deals 10% less damage and gains 25% less Block. 1 stack expires each turn.

entombed.name: Entombed
entombed.tooltip: Skips its next turn. Takes 25% less damage while entombed.

base.persistent-block.name: Persistent Block
base.persistent-block.tooltip: Replenish Block up to remaining stacks at turn start. A connected physical hit consumes one stack, including fully blocked hits.

base.persistent-barrier.name: Persistent Barrier
base.persistent-barrier.tooltip: Replenish Barrier up to remaining stacks at turn start. A connected magical hit consumes one stack, including fully protected hits.

base.greased.name: Greased
base.greased.tooltip: Melee/Reach accuracy -20. At turn start 25% chance to become Prone. Fire cannot miss: triple damage, Burn 3, and splash 1.5 times the original incoming fire damage to other same-side actors.

base.poison.name: Poison
base.poison.tooltip: At turn start take 1 necrotic damage per stack. Unlike Venom, this is direct ongoing damage, without a buildup threshold. Lose one stack at turn end.

base.blight.name: Blight
base.blight.tooltip: If Blight stacks reach current HP, die immediately. Lose one stack at turn end.

base.weak.name: Weak
base.weak.tooltip: Deal 25% less direct damage while active. Additional stacks extend duration; they do not multiply the penalty.

base.charm.name: Charm
base.charm.tooltip: Direct attack accuracy -25 while active. Lose one stack at turn end.

base.bind.name: Bind
base.bind.tooltip: Cannot play Attack cards. Skill, Power and recovery cards remain available. Lose one stack at turn end.

base.restrained.name: Restrained
base.restrained.tooltip: Melee and Reach cards cost 1 extra Stamina while active. This is separate from a generated Restrained burden card.

base.foresight.name: Foresight
base.foresight.tooltip: Each stack grants +2 Perception for detecting Veil. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

base.evade.name: Evade
base.evade.tooltip: Consume one stack when a direct physical hit is attempted: 25% chance to avoid the entire action. Failed attempts also consume the stack.

base.intangible.name: Intangible
base.intangible.tooltip: Direct hit damage is capped at 1; ongoing damage is unaffected. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

base.mirrors.name: Mirrors
base.mirrors.tooltip: Double direct outgoing damage. Additional stacks extend duration, without exponential multiplication. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

base.elemental-weapon.name: Elemental Weapon
base.elemental-weapon.tooltip: Weapon attacks add a separate 3 Fire damage packet. The packet does not recursively trigger enchantments or reactions.

base.necrotic-healing.name: Necrotic Renewal
base.necrotic-healing.tooltip: Incoming necrotic damage becomes equal healing, before protection. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

base.divine-harm.name: Profane Inversion
base.divine-harm.tooltip: Incoming Divine healing becomes equal Sacred damage. Ordinary healing is unchanged. Lose one stack at turn end.

base.extra-weapon.name: Extra Weapon
base.extra-weapon.tooltip: The next weapon Attack repeats its primary damage once, without repeating card payment or recursively creating another action.

base.extra-shield.name: Extra Shield
base.extra-shield.tooltip: The next shield/guard card repeats its protection once, without repeating payment or reactions.

base.auto-counter.name: Automatic Counter
base.auto-counter.tooltip: After a hostile direct Melee/Reach hit connects, consume a stack and return 6 physical damage. Reaction damage cannot trigger another automatic reaction.

base.auto-sweep.name: Automatic Sweep
base.auto-sweep.tooltip: After a hostile direct hit connects, consume a stack and deal 4 physical damage to each opposing actor. Reaction damage cannot recurse.

base.reflect.name: Reflect
base.reflect.tooltip: Reflect half actual HP damage from hostile direct hits, rounded down. Reflected damage never reflects again.

base.guard-allies.name: Interpose
base.guard-allies.tooltip: Intercept up to 4 direct damage per stack for another ally, consuming one stack per interception. The lowest actor ID wins competing guards.

base.veil.name: Veil
base.veil.tooltip: Single-target actions must detect the bearer. Chance is 50% plus 5% per Perception advantage, minus 10% per Veil stack, clamped to 5–95%. Area actions bypass Veil.

base.retain-block.name: Hold Block
base.retain-block.tooltip: Retain up to 4 existing Block per stack when Block would expire. This does not create protection or duplicate Persistent Block.

base.read-intent.name: Read Intent
base.read-intent.tooltip: Marks a targeted Read Intent. The read belongs to its owner and selected enemy. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

base.stagger.name: Stagger
base.stagger.tooltip: Visible burden tracking only. The generated card owns its action loss or resource tax, so this marker never applies it twice.

base.paralysis.name: Paralysis
base.paralysis.tooltip: Visible burden tracking only. The generated card owns its action loss or resource tax, so this marker never applies it twice.

base.restrained-burden.name: Restrained Burden
base.restrained-burden.tooltip: Visible burden tracking only. The generated card owns its action loss or resource tax, so this marker never applies it twice.

base.many-forms.name: Many Forms
base.many-forms.tooltip: Each stack permits one additional concurrent stance. One stack allows two total stances. Lose one stack at the next turn start.

base.conceal.name: Conceal
base.conceal.tooltip: Each stack increases cards hidden and their hidden duration by one. Lose one stack at owner turn start.
